title: Activation-scale Autotuner and INT8 Deployment Pipeline with Runtime Fused Rescale Kernel
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Implement an activation-scale autotuner and end-to-end INT8 deployment pipeline (activation-aware quantization) that produces production-ready quantization profiles and a low-overhead fused rescale+quantize runtime kernel. This ticket covers: (1) an automated offline calibration mode that derives per-layer activation scaling factors using both per-tensor and per-channel heuristics, (2) an autotuning stage that evaluates candidate scaling strategies against a held-out accuracy slice and latency budget, (3) generation of a compact quantization profile (per-layer scale + type hints) that can be pinned to model versions, and (4) runtime integration of a fused rescale+quantize kernel with a graceful fallback to the FP16 path when accuracy regressions or kernel incompatibilities are detected. This work must consider KV-cache correctness, continuous batching, and interaction with prefix caching and beam/search strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Autotuner produces reproducible per-layer activation scales and a profile JSON that the runtime can consume
Fused rescale+quantize kernel implemented for CUDA and validated for top-3 transformer blocks; unit tests cover numerics vs FP32 baseline
End-to-end calibration -> runtime pipeline reduces token compute cost by >= 18% for target models while keeping top-line eval metric degradation <= 0.8% on validation slices
Can roll back automatically to FP16 kernel on accuracy/regression detection via Console rollout policy
CI includes nightly regression tests (small eval set) and perf microbenchmarks for latency/throughput across batch sizes 1..32
implementation_notes: Calibration harness: sample representative prompts, record activation statistics (mean, std, max-percentile), and produce candidate scale maps
Autotuner: grid search + targeted binary search on per-layer scale multipliers with early-stopping based on validation metric and latency budget
Profile format: flattened list of layer ids -> {scale_multiplier, quant_type, per_channel_flag} (compact JSON for pinning in model metadata)

Runtime kernel: implement fused op that applies activation rescale (float multiply) then quantize-to-int8 with nearest-even rounding; provide vectorized CUDA kernel with fallback path that calls existing FP16 op
KV cache handling: ensure cached keys maintain original FP32/FP16 formats; when serving INT8 with cached keys, runtime must rescale restored KV entries or use compatibility mode to avoid drift
Rollout strategy: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% with auto-rollback on quality/regression alert from Redwood Optimize
Metrics: track per-route token cost, per-model token latency, and a small suite of eval metrics (perplexity, exact-match for QA slices, BLEU for summarization samples)
